offer.text: My little one wants to gather flowers by the meadow, but I daren't let them go alone. Keep them safe for a couple of minutes while they pick?

accept.text: Bless you. Don't let them out of your sight.

decline.text: Then they'll have to stay inside today.

in_progress.text: Are they still safe? Keep close to them.

ready.text: Safe and sound, with an armful of flowers! Thank you.

complete.text: You watched over my child as if they were your own. I won't forget that.

failed.text: My child... no. I should never have let them out. Leave me.
